name: smwpatches-level-dependent-yoshi-message-v1
title: Level Dependent Yoshi Message V1.1
description:
This patch allows different Yoshi Rescued messages each level, depending on level number. Might also be useful for someone wanting to use more than 2 messages per level.

Moderator's note: You can only set a message per translevel (0x000-0x024 and 0x101-0x13B). This means that you have to set the message for the level the player enters from the overworld rather than the level they actually might encounter Yoshi in.
You must also change a message in LM's message editor at least once for the patch to work.

Yoshifanatic's update:
- Removed an instance of xkas style left to right math.
- Made the patch throw an error if the overworld hasn't been saved in Lunar Magic, as this patch hijacks LM's message text routine.
- Made it so that the first parameter of the macros is now the level ID rather than $13BF values.
- Added support for Lunar Magic's optional ASM hack for the increased level+event slots.
- Allows you to choose whether the message displays or not and whether $0EF8 is checked before displaying the message.
